data.name: Hahseen
data.gender_notes: Hahseen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'hassanah' which means 'to please', 'to delight', 'to be beautiful'. This name is often used for both boys and girls. The name Hahseen carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hahseen usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hahseen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, pleasure, beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hahseen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
